drhp.business: The Company is engaged in the manufacturing, conversion, distribution, and sale of X-Ray films and NTR films in both matte and glossy finishes. The Company procures Jumbo Rolls of X-Ray films and undertakes slitting and packaging operations at its Dadra unit, and the conventional Medical X-Ray Film market it serves is undergoing structural transformation due to increasing adoption of digital imaging technologies.
